review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–64). It has no @[simp] declarations and no simp-set interface of its own. It has two instances and three lemmas, all stated as an iff or a HasLiftingProperty. None is an equation that should be a simp rewrite, and none has a direction that could cause a loop or compete with another rule. The proofs use only `simp` on `CommSq 0 0 p f` and on the lift's factorization goal. These are closed by existing zero-morphism simp lemmas, and I saw no sign that a missing simp lemma was being worked around. The two iff lemmas relate Projective to an llp membership. Making them simp would expand `Projective P` into a larger condition, which is undesirable, so I would not recommend it. I did not look for downstream uses elsewhere in Mathlib. I found no justified simp-interface finding.
